experience.description: Optimized routing matrices and delivery vehicles to ensure 100% SLA adherence. Supervised dispatch riders and field personnel to reduce delivery turnaround times.

Evaluated chat interactions against quality matrices and provided data-driven coaching. Designed refresher training modules to elevate campaign performance scores.
Managed high-volume customer interactions, ensuring professional communication and effective resolution of challenging situations.
